verdict.rationale: Yubico's official ykman CLI is documented as scriptable device management covering device info, enabled applications and PIV/OATH/OTP slots, and Yubico docs name ykman as a way to read firmware version, so an agent can query a single key's state. Fleet-wide auditing is not shown: the YubiEnterprise REST API covers delivery, inventory and shipment, not live device state. missing for 10: explicit serial-number readout, documented enumeration of stored credentials, machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output for agents, fleet-level aggregation of device state, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read a key's state programmatically — serial, firmware version, enabled applications, stored credentials — to audit security posture across a fleet

citations.quote: Full scriptable device management: enable applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots, device info.
The quickest and most convenient way to determine your device's firmware version is to use either the Yubico Authenticator ... or ykman
